description: This Python module integrates Strands Agents into the Pipecat framework, enabling conversational AI interactions through either single agents or multi-agent graphs. It defines a class `StrandsAgentsProcessor` that manages frame processing, invokes Strands agents or graphs, and handles streaming and metrics.

classes.name: StrandsAgentsProcessor
classes.description: Processor that integrates Strands Agents with Pipecat's frame pipeline, capable of handling both single agent and multi-agent graph workflows, processing frames, invoking agents, streaming responses, and collecting metrics.
